applicationFee.note: Graduate School event participation: register if required, arrive within first 10 minutes and stay most of event. Verified waiver automatically posts in 2–3 business days; one future-term application. Current students/alumni automatic; external CAS excluded. Confirm international eligibility; no nationality restriction stated.

english.note: Pearson 56; official agency scores valid 2 years. US high-school/college/university graduates or listed-country citizens exempt. English-instruction degree may receive discretionary Dean waiver by petition; not automatic.

requirements.note: Accredited bachelor; international comparable degree/B average and GPA 3.0 in major. Submit application before supplemental upload prompts. Program currently lists General GRE required; confirm any discretionary central exception directly.

funding.note: Full-time teaching assistantships available with full tuition/monthly stipend; qualified students may receive external-grant research assistantships covering tuition. No all-admitted or explicit international guarantee/amount established.
